requirement.statement: 系统 SHALL provide an engineering knowledge registry at `codument/engineering/` as an XNL working tree for long-lived implementation, maintenance, operations, reference, and troubleshooting knowledge, replacing free-form `docs/impl` as the managed source of truth when enabled.

case.when: The system materializes long-lived implementation knowledge
case.then: The knowledge SHALL be stored as XNL files under `codument/engineering/<plane>/<category>/...`
case.and: The system SHALL preserve `engineering` as separate from `modeling`, `behaviors`, `decisions`, and `memory`

case.when: The system records history and collaboration
case.then: `codument/engineering/**.xnl` SHALL be versioned by the host project git
case.and: Ephemeral xnl-vfs/xnl-vcs artifacts SHALL NOT be persisted in the registry

requirement.statement: 系统 SHALL define engineering knowledge nodes as XNL elements with stable ids, implementation-oriented kinds, and minimal required representations per kind.

case.then: The system SHALL support `overview`, `howto`, `rule`, `example`, `reference`, `troubleshooting`, `runbook`, and `code-map` kinds

case.given: An engineering node of a given kind
case.then: `howto` and `runbook` SHALL include steps and verification
case.and: `troubleshooting` SHALL include symptoms, diagnosis, and fix

requirement.statement: 系统 SHALL express a track's long-lived engineering knowledge changes as target-state nodes under `engineering_deltas/` and apply them through the same conservative node-level three-way merge model used by modeling.

case.given: A track produces long-lived engineering knowledge
case.when: The track is authored or implemented
case.then: The change SHALL be written under `tracks/<id>/engineering_deltas/<plane>/<category>/<topic>.xnl`

case.given: A completed track contains engineering deltas
case.when: The track is archived and engineering is enabled
case.then: The system SHALL merge base, ours, and theirs with a node-level three-way merge keyed by node id
case.and: True conflicts SHALL be reported issues-first unless explicitly resolved by policy

requirement.statement: 系统 SHALL gate engineering registry behavior behind `codument/config/engineering.xml`, disabled by default, and SHALL provide `codument engineering validate` and `codument engineering lint` commands.

case.given: A workspace has no enabled engineering config
case.when: track create, implement, archive, or default engineering validation runs
case.then: The system SHALL skip engineering behavior and leave existing behavior unchanged

case.given: An engineering registry or engineering delta tree exists
case.then: The system SHALL report syntax, schema, hierarchy, and reference findings in an author-friendly format

case.given: An engineering XNL file exceeds configured line or node thresholds
case.then: The system SHALL flag it as a fractal-split candidate
